data.name: Name
data.search_body: Also filter on the ad body

data_description.url: Copy it from your browser's address bar.
data_description.require_keywords: Comma = alternatives, space = all words required. Example: apple tv, appletv
data_description.exclude_keywords: Same syntax. Beware of over-broad terms: 'telecommande' would also reject 'Apple TV without remote'.
data_description.notify_services: notify services to call, for example your companion app and Telegram.
data_description.critical: Rings through silent mode and Do Not Disturb. Requires Critical Alerts to be allowed for Home Assistant in iOS settings.
data_description.poll_seconds: 90 s detects a new ad in under two minutes. Lower adds nothing and degrades the traffic profile.
data_description.quiet_start: No polling and no alerts during this window. Ads found are grouped into a quiet digest at the end of it.
data_description.max_ads: Guard against a flood of alerts.

error.not_leboncoin: This is not a leboncoin.fr URL.
error.no_query: This URL has no search criteria. Apply your filters on leboncoin, then copy the address.
error.bad_param: A search parameter contains a character that cannot be handled.
error.blocked: Leboncoin refused the request (DataDome). This is usually temporary — try again in a minute.
error.filters_match_nothing: The search returns {total} ads but your keywords reject all of them. Loosen them.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while running the search. Check the logs.
